thread:
Anya: Heads up — onboarding ceres-8b-q5 to staging. Quick smoke shows a drop in multilingual recall on the promptset, especially code-switch + longform prompts. Anyone else seeing this?
Sam: saw that too. Failing examples in the multilang/code-switch bucket. Dedupe flagged a lot as near-duplicates but human labels disagree. Link to failing evals: https://ci.redwood/canaries/ceres-8b-q5/16999 :eyes:
Raj: probable tokenizer mismatch — ceres uses the new spm variant. Token splits + byte fallback make our fingerprint and dedupe thresholds misfire. I can run a tokenizer diff and regen fingerprints.
Luke: labelers are reporting truncation on mixed-language prompts and weird spacing around emojis, leads to truncated completions in ~20% of failing cases. Attaching first few traces in thread. :thinking_face:
Maria: Labeling ops can spin up a microgolden set — we have 3 annotators today (250 samples) and can scale to 5 tomorrow for hand-labeling. Need the sample list and instructions.
Anya: thanks. Quick fetch for failing ids (run in eval-harness):
```
POST /eval/query
{ "model": "ceres-8b-q5", "filter": { "bucket": "multilang_codeswitch", "status": "fail" }, "limit": 500 }
```
Grab top by failure-rate then stratify by locale + length.
label-bot: Canary deployment note: ceres-8b-q5 (canary-2026-03-??) deployed to staging at 1717609950. Perf perf/latency snapshots uploaded.
Sam: proposed plan:
1) rerun dedupe with lang-aware tokenizer and lower fingerprint radius for mixed-linguals
2) assemble microgolden (250 stratified samples) for labelers + eval baseline
3) rerun quant-calibration with longer kv-cache for long prompts and compare regressed metrics to float baseline
Can someone own (1)?
Raj: I got (1). Will push a patch to the dedupe pipeline and a small tool `scripts/lang_fingerprint.py`:
```
# usage
python scripts/lang_fingerprint.py --model ceres-8b-q5 --buckets 6 --lang-aware
```
I'll output new fp sets to s3://redwood-curation/ceres8b/q5/fp-v2/ by EOD.
Maria: I'll build the microgolden. Want it stratified by: en/es mixed, en/hi mixed, zh/en, pt/en, and high-emoji prompts. Also split by length: short <128, mid 128-512, long >512. Will add labeling instructions: focus on recall/intent-preservation and hallucination flags.
Anya: also add an automatic rollout fallback: if regression delta > 6% on microgolden recall we route to float-baseline (ceres-8b-fp32) for that customer tier. I'll draft a canary fallback rule `rollouts/ceres_fallback.yaml` and wire it into the smart-router.
Luke: pasting two failing traces (trimmed):
```
# req 1
> prompt: "Mix EN/HI: क्या मेरा बैंक अकाउंट अभी एक्टिव है? pls summarize"
> model: ceres-8b-q5
> output: "Your account is active." <-- missing qualifier, chopped after emoji
# req 2
> prompt: "en+zh: How to reset 密码?"
> output: "To reset" <stops unexpectedly, no steps>
```
These looked fine on float baseline.
Sam: ok owners: Raj -> dedupe/lang-fp, Maria -> microgolden + labeler ops, Luke -> gather traces + send labeler examples, Anya -> rollout + eval harness changes. I'll run regression diffs once Raj/Maria push artifacts. 30m sync in #eng-ml if anyone can join. :thumbsup:
